kitchen_join.meta_description: Sell your food on BhojanGo: commission on food only, weekly payouts and your own prices. Start your application in a few minutes.
kitchen_join.title: Bring your kitchen to more hungry customers
kitchen_join.lead: Commission on food only, payouts every week, and your prices stay yours. Customers see the whole bill, so they trust it.
kitchen_join.hero_alt: A cook lifts a large naan from the tandoor in a busy restaurant kitchen
kitchen_join.facts_label: BhojanGo for kitchens at a glance
kitchen_join.why_commission_range: Between {min}% and {max}% of the food in each order, set by your kitchen's tier.
kitchen_join.why_commission_one: {percent}% of the food in each order.
kitchen_join.why_commission_never: Never on delivery fees, taxes or tips.
kitchen_join.why_commission_unknown: Commission is a share of the food in each order, never of delivery fees, taxes or tips. Your rate shows on your application before you go live.

why_payout_body.one: Each Monday-to-Sunday week is settled after it ends, with a {count}-day hold for refunds, straight to your bank account.
why_payout_body.other: Each Monday-to-Sunday week is settled after it ends, with a {count}-day hold for refunds, straight to your bank account.

kitchen_join.why_payout_body_biweekly: Your earnings are settled every two weeks, straight to your bank account.
kitchen_join.why_prices_body: You set your menu prices. Run offers you fund yourself, with a weekly cap so they never cost more than you planned.
kitchen_join.why_bill_body: Customers see every line of the bill and who gets it: your kitchen, the delivery partner, tax and BhojanGo.
kitchen_join.bill_kitchen_gets: The kitchen's payout from this order: {amount}
kitchen_join.how_1_body: Create your kitchen partner account with your kitchen's name and city.
kitchen_join.how_2_body: Add your address, licence, tax details and bank account here, at your own pace. Every step is saved.
kitchen_join.how_3_body: Set up your dishes and prices with your BhojanGo account manager, then keep them fresh, photos too, in the BhojanGo Kitchen app on your tablet.
kitchen_join.how_4_body: We check everything and switch your kitchen on. New orders ring in the BhojanGo Kitchen app.
kitchen_join.docs_lead: Have these ready. You can add them one at a time: your application is saved as you go.
kitchen_join.docs_none: We'll tell you what's needed for your city when you apply.
kitchen_join.faq_fees_q: What does it cost to join?
kitchen_join.faq_fees_a: Nothing to join. BhojanGo earns a commission on the food in each order (shown above), and offers you choose to run come out of your payout. Delivery fees, taxes and tips are never part of your commission.
kitchen_join.faq_payouts_a: You add your bank account during your application and our payments partner verifies it. Each payout is your food sales minus commission and any offers you funded. The BhojanGo Kitchen app shows a statement with every order.
kitchen_join.faq_delivery_a: BhojanGo delivery partners. You accept the order on your tablet, cook and pack it, and a delivery partner picks it up from your counter and brings it to the customer.
kitchen_join.faq_tablet_q: What do I need to take orders?
kitchen_join.faq_tablet_a: An Android tablet or an iPad (a phone works too) with the BhojanGo Kitchen app and an internet connection. Keep it at the counter with the sound on: it rings for every new order. You sign in to it with your mobile number and a code we text you.
kitchen_join.faq_approval_a: We review your application as soon as every step is done. Most of the time goes into checking documents, so having them ready is the quickest way through. This page always shows where your application stands.
kitchen_join.faq_prices_q: Can I set my own prices and offers?
kitchen_join.faq_prices_a: Yes. Your menu prices are yours, and you can run offers you fund, with a weekly cap. The bill shows customers who pays for each offer.
kitchen_join.faq_account_q: I already order on BhojanGo. Can I use that account?
kitchen_join.faq_account_a: A kitchen needs its own account: one account is either a customer's or a kitchen partner's. An account that has never ordered can become your kitchen's account; otherwise apply with a different email and mobile number.
kitchen_join.faq_later_q: Can I finish my application later?
kitchen_join.faq_later_a: Yes. Every step is saved. Sign in with the email or mobile number you applied with, come back to this page, and you'll pick up where you left off.
